summary: Router 0.27.0 adds a start-time posture check from the running process's own view (/proc/self/mountinfo, owner/mode, effective capabilities): the medium finding tls_files_changeable when the router could change or replace control_tls.cert/key or a folder above them (ADR-0081). Read-only: the check opens no file for writing, follows no path the configuration does not name, and never reads certificate or key contents.

findings.evidence: ADR-0073 protects only /etc/skirnir-router/certs. A deployment kept its certificate copy in another folder below /etc/skirnir-router that a root install step writes and that the router (root without capabilities, ReadWritePaths=/etc/skirnir-router) could change or replace; nothing reported it.
findings.resolution: The running router reports tls_files_changeable (medium) with the next step. Checks file content (writable mount + owner/mode), every folder above (rename/replace), mount points (cannot be renamed), sticky folders, symlink and target. Tests mirror the unit's mount table; a counter-check with three broken variants (mounts ignored, folders not walked, owner/mode ignored) fails 4, 3 and 3 tests.

findings.evidence: A check that raised at start (stat of a path the process cannot reach, dangling link) would stop the router before it serves.
findings.resolution: Paths are checked with lexists before any stat; the target of a link is only stat-ed when it exists; folders of a reachable entry are searchable by construction. No try/except added; a dangling-link test covers both a read-only and a writable folder.
Only the setting name and the configured path are printed (as config.yaml already holds them); no file content, owner, or other path.

tests.command: python test/selftest_process_view.py (Windows and WSL Ubuntu with the CI venv)
tests.evidence: Ran 13 tests: OK (1 skipped per platform); on Linux the current process's own view is checked as well.
mounts ignored: FAILED (4); folders never checked: FAILED (3); owner/mode ignored: FAILED (3).
OK; CLI posture unchanged (no view passed).

tests.command: ruff check .; python test/check_adr_index.py; python test/check_control_flow.py
tests.evidence: All checks passed; ADR index ok: 81 ADRs; control flow ok.

limitations: ACLs and security modules are not read; they can only remove rights, so the check may over-report, never under-report.
The finding only appears in the start log of the running router; router.py --posture cannot see the unit's view.
